title: FHFA House Price Index — monthly index (October 2027 data), 9:00 a.m. ET — the one edition with no Conference Board on its morning
source: FHFA: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this session, independently of the sweep that proposed this id. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) -- its "2027 HPI Release Dates" table, twelfth and last of the dated rows, reads "Tuesday, December 28 | Monthly Index | October 2027"; the four rows the same table marks "Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables)" are February 23, May 25, August 31 and November 30, so this row is a MONTHLY edition by the publisher own labelling rather than by inference. (2) The published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page carries the identical row directly beneath the statement "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data" -- a published document rather than a second reading of the same web table, and the source of the 9:00 a.m. ET time. Its 517 stream objects were located and 511 inflated in-session with node zlib, then text-extracted from the Tj/TJ operators; this runner has no pdftotext. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on the precedent nine sibling lanes have set (fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24, -2026-12-29, -2027-01-26, -2027-02-23, -2027-08-31, -2027-09-28, -2027-10-26, new-home-sales-2026-11-25, construction-spending-2026-12-01): the no-self-confirm limit binds the DISCOVERING sweep (fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26), not this event own independent second look. 2027-12-28 is the last Tuesday of December 2027 and a full NYSE session, consistent with the rule the other eleven 2027 rows follow. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26 initial-research sweep (2026-09-06) as the last untracked 2027 FHFA edition, and researched 2026-09-08; the proposal file is now shadowed by this canonical one. INITIAL RESEARCH (docs/research/events/fhfa-hpi-2027-12-28.md) OVERTURNS THE ONE CLAIM THE PROPOSAL CARRIED FORWARD FROM THE CHAIN, AND IT IS THE CHAIN CENTRAL CONFOUND. (1) THE CONFERENCE BOARD IS NOT ON THIS MORNING, AND HAS NOT BEEN ON ANY DECEMBER FHFA MORNING SINCE THE MODERN RULE BEGAN. Seven FHFA ledgers have declined every daily-bar design on the ground that Consumer Confidence at 10:00 shares the session with FHFA at 9:00 -- stated as an identity covering 67 of 67 post-policy releases. It is not an identity in December: the Conference Board does not use the last Tuesday in December, and this session reproduced three of the five post-policy December dates from the November editions own announced-in-advance next-release lines, fetched direct 2026-09-08 (CCI-Nov-2022 "next release is Wednesday, December 21"; CCI-Nov-2023 "Wednesday, December 20"; CCI-Nov-2024 "Monday, December 23rd"), against FHFA December releases on 2022-12-27, 2023-12-26 and 2024-12-31. The gaps are 6, 6, 6, 8 and 7 days across 2021-2025 -- 0 of 5 shared sessions, different weeks every year. So the true pairing count is at most 62 of 67, and the five Decembers are the exception the chain never noticed. (2) THE DESIGN THE CHAIN SAID DID NOT EXIST, USED, RETURNS NULL. Because December releases are Conference-Board-free, a plain daily bar IS a clean design for them. Run on CBOE own index history over the monthly era with VIX9D (15 December releases, 2011-2025): null against every control, including VIX9D/VIX p=1.0000 against a matched year-end pool. Post-policy alone (n=5, 2021-2025) it is null too, smallest p=0.2405. (3) THE THIRD REGIME AXIS, AND IT KEYS ON SESSION COUNT NOT CALENDAR DATE. The 10-26 lane established that Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct releases must be controlled on FOMC blackout membership. December needs its own: the year-end window compresses the front of the vol curve at VIX9D/VIX 0.9006 vs 0.9422, p=0.0016 (n=75 vs 3,866, seed-stable 0.0013-0.0019) while the VIX LEVEL does not move (p=0.4630). Defining that window by TRADING-SESSION COUNT (the last five sessions of the year) is roughly four times sharper than the fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29 lane calendar-date Dec 24-31 window (p=0.0065, seed-stable 0.0065-0.0082) -- a measured method improvement, not a preference. All five post-policy December releases sit inside that window, 5 of 5, and 2027-12-28 will too. (4) DECEMBER IS CLEAN ON THE FED AXIS, ARITHMETICALLY. The last Tuesday of December is in an FOMC blackout 0 of 7 and is an FOMC meeting day 0 of 7 across 2021-2027, and the margin is structural rather than lucky: the December meeting has fallen on Dec 7-18 in all seven years, so its blackout closes at least six days before the last Tuesday. (5) THE CLEAN 09:00 ET PRE-MARKET WINDOW REPLICATES OUT OF SESSION. Re-fetched from Yahoo two days after the 10-26 lane built it: 728 sessions with a 09:00 bar, 34 release mornings, median |return| 3.6961 vs 8.5903 bps (p=0.0199 against that lane 0.0196), range 30.78 vs 52.07 (p=0.0294), signed return p=0.6586, pre-market volume 0 on 34 of 34. The December subsample is n=3 and is not tested. (6) SCHEDULE RISK IS REAL BUT ITS ERA ENDED. December is the one month FHFA has moved -- 6 of 18 monthly-era Decembers landed on the last Tuesday, with 2008-2017 all publishing Dec 20-24 -- but every departure predates 2021, the 2018 case is explained (its last Tuesday WAS Christmas Day), and the rule has held 5 of 5 since. (7) CONTENT: October is the seventh reference month tested and stays refuted -- 14 of 14 positive since 2012 (median +0.4572%), 32 of 35 all-time, separating at p=0.9535 all-time and p=0.8145 since 2012, reproducing the fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29 kill. The live regime is flat: last six m/m 4 of 6 positive, median +0.084%. (8) CORRIDOR: 2027-12-24 is a FULL NYSE CLOSURE, not a half day -- Christmas Day 2027 falls on a Saturday, and in all five prior Saturday-Christmas years (1993, 1999, 2004, 2010, 2021) December 24 is absent from CBOE own 9,267-session index history. Proposed here as christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24.
